theorem_title: Execution of the complete common-prime chain
formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBandPrimeChain.program_meets (primes : ℕ → ℕ) (rs : List _root_.ThreeSum.BandCandidateRows.Record)
    (hw : (lim.space : ℤ) ≤ lim.word) (hs : 0 < s) (hg : 0 < g)
    (ha : a+nA ≤ free) (hb : b+nB ≤ free) (hc : c+nC ≤ free)
    (hrecs : recs+4*rs.length ≤ free) (haux : aux+s ≤ free)
    (hspace : _root_.ThreeSum.LightBandPrimeChain.space free maxMod g U levels ≤ lim.space)
    (hword : (_root_.ThreeSum.LightBandWeightedScore.word maxMod nA nB nC g rs.length s U : ℤ) ≤ lim.word)
    (hd : d+Nat.clog 2 maxMod+8 ≤ lim.depth)
    (hrecords : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Seg μ recs (_root_.ThreeSum.BandCandidateRows.cells rs))
    (hflag : ∀ r ∈ rs, r.flag=0 ∨ r.flag=1)
    (hvalid : ∀ r ∈ rs, r.flag=1 → r.a*g ≤ nA ∧ r.b*g ≤ nB ∧ r.c*g ≤ nC)
    (hA : ∀ i < nA, |μ (a+i)| ≤ (U : ℤ))
    (hB : ∀ i < nB, |μ (b+i)| ≤ (U : ℤ))
    (hC : ∀ i < nC, |μ (c+i)| ≤ (U : ℤ))
    (hread : ∀ i < s, μ (aux+i)=(primes i : ℤ))
    (hprime : ∀ i < s, Nat.Prime (primes i))
    (hinj : ∀ i < s, ∀ j < s, primes i=primes j → i=j)
    (hhi : ∀ i < s, primes i ≤ Y)
    (hmax : Y^(levels+1) ≤ maxMod) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Meets lim _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBandPrimeChain.program 18 d [a,b,c,nA,nB,nC,g,recs,rs.length,aux,s,levels,free] μ
      (_root_.ThreeSum.LightBandPrimeChain.time maxMod g rs.length s U levels)
      (fun result ν =>
        result=(_root_.ThreeSum.BandPrimeChoice.modulus primes s nA nB nC g
          (fun i => μ (a+i)) (fun i => μ (b+i)) (fun i => μ (c+i)) rs levels : ℤ) ∧
        (∀ i ≤ levels, ν (free+i)=(_root_.ThreeSum.BandPrimeChoice.modulus primes s nA nB nC g
          (fun j => μ (a+j)) (fun j => μ (b+j)) (fun j => μ (c+j)) rs i : ℤ)) ∧
        _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Kept μ ν free) := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
Let $s>0$, positive band size $g$, chain depth $K$, prime bound $Y$ and maximum intermediate modulus $M$ be natural numbers. Suppose memory retains original integer arrays A,B,C bounded by $U$, Boolean physical owner records with all flagged band starts in range, and $s$ distinct auxiliary primes $p_i\le Y$, all before free address $f$. Assume $Y^{K+1}\le M$, addresses fit words, the exact chain-space and aggregate-score word bounds fit and depth $d+\lceil\log_2M\rceil+8$ is allowed. Then the fixed prime-chain program writes each recursively selected common modulus $q_j$ for $0\le j\le K$ at $f+j$, returns

$$q_K,$$

meets its prescribed full-chain time and preserves every cell below $f$. Here the sequence $q_j$ is the deterministic modulus chain defined by the exact aggregate band-owner weighted score.

This executes every common-modulus choice while retaining the complete chain for the later false-score bound.
